import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)

# Find section for Public institutions
# r63 is 'Public institutions'
# Col A has Year, Col C has Current dollars -> Total tuition, fees, room, and board -> 4-year (Col C, index 2)
public_row = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Public institutions')].index[0]
next_section = df.iloc[public_row+1:][df.iloc[public_row+1:][0].astype(str).str.contains('Private', na=False)].index[0]

sub_df = df.iloc[public_row+1:next_section]
row_2022 = sub_df[sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('2022-23')]
result = float(row_2022[2].values[0])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)

# Tuition and required fees in Current dollars for 4-year is Col F (index 5)
# Sections: Nonprofit (r177), For-profit (r202)
nonprofit_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'Nonprofit'].index[0]
forprofit_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'For-profit'].index[0]

# 2022-23 row in Nonprofit section
np_2022 = df.iloc[nonprofit_idx:forprofit_idx]
np_val = float(np_2022[np_2022[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('2022-23')][5].values[0])

# 2022-23 row in For-profit section
fp_df = df.iloc[forprofit_idx:]
fp_val = float(fp_df[fp_df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('2022-23')][5].values[0])

result = 'yes' if np_val > fp_val else 'no'

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)

# Across all institutions: section 'All institutions' (starts r6)
# Constant 2022-23 dollars -> Total tuition, fees, room, and board -> All institutions (Col N, index 13)
all_inst_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'All institutions'].index[0]
public_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Public institutions')].index[0]

sub_df = df.iloc[all_inst_idx+1:public_idx].copy()
sub_df = sub_df[sub_df[0].astype(str).str.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}')]

years = ['2015-16', '2016-17', '2017-18', '2018-19', '2019-20', '2020-21', '2021-22', '2022-23']
sub_df['year'] = sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip()
sub_df = sub_df[sub_df['year'].isin(years)]

sub_df[13] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[13])
max_row = sub_df.loc[sub_df[13].idxmax()]
result = str(max_row['year'])

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('nces_digest_tuition_fees_room_board.xlsx', sheet_name='Digest 2023 Table 330.10', header=None)

# All institutions: r6 to r62
# Constant 2022-23 dollars -> Total tuition, fees, room, board -> 4-year is Col O (index 14)
all_inst_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip() == 'All institutions'].index[0]
public_idx = df[df[0].astype(str).str.strip().str.startswith('Public institutions')].index[0]

sub_df = df.iloc[all_inst_idx+1:public_idx].copy()
sub_df['year'] = sub_df[0].astype(str).str.strip()

# Filter for 2000-01 through 2022-23
# Extract start year
sub_df = sub_df[sub_df['year'].str.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}')]
sub_df['start_year'] = sub_df['year'].apply(lambda x: int(x.split('-')[0]))
sub_df = sub_df[(sub_df['start_year'] >= 2000) & (sub_df['start_year'] <= 2022)]

sub_df[14] = pd.to_numeric(sub_df[14])
result = int((sub_df[14] > 30000).sum())
